verses.en: We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
verses.pt: Ó Deus, nós ouvimos com os nossos ouvidos, nossos pais nos têm contado os feitos que realizaste em seus dias, nos tempos da antigüidade.
verses.en_web: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us, what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. Of the sons of Korah Maschil.> It has come to our ears, O God, our fathers have given us the story, of the works which you did in their days, in the old times,

verses.en: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
verses.pt: Tu expeliste as nações com a tua mão, mas a eles plantaste; afligiste os povos, mas a eles estendes-te largamente.
verses.en_web: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
verses.en_bbe: Uprooting the nations with your hand, and planting our fathers in their place; cutting down the nations, but increasing the growth of your people.

verses.en: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
verses.pt: Pois não foi pela sua espada que conquistaram a terra, nem foi o seu braço que os salvou, mas a tua destra e o teu braço, e a luz do teu rosto, porquanto te agradaste deles.
verses.en_web: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
verses.en_bbe: For they did not make the land theirs by their swords, and it was not their arms which kept them safe; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your face, because you had pleasure in them.

verses.en: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
verses.pt: Tu és o meu Rei, ó Deus; ordena livramento para Jacó.
verses.en_web: You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!
verses.en_bbe: You are my King and my God; ordering salvation for Jacob.

verses.en: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
verses.pt: Por ti derrubamos os nossos adversários; pelo teu nome pisamos os que se levantam contra nós.
verses.en_web: Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, will we tread them under who rise up against us.
verses.en_bbe: Through you will we overcome our haters; by your name will they be crushed under our feet who are violent against us.

verses.en: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
verses.pt: Pois não confio no meu arco, nem a minha espada me pode salvar.
verses.en_web: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
verses.en_bbe: I will not put faith in my bow, my sword will not be my salvation.

verses.en: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
verses.pt: Mas tu nos salvaste dos nossos adversários, e confundiste os que nos odeiam.
verses.en_web: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
verses.en_bbe: But it is you who have been our saviour from those who were against us, and have put to shame those who had hate for us.

verses.en: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
verses.pt: Em Deus é que nos temos gloriado o dia todo, e sempre louvaremos o teu nome.
verses.en_web: In God we have made our boast all day long, we will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Our pride is in God at all times, to his name we give praise for ever. (Selah.)

verses.en: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
verses.pt: Mas agora nos rejeitaste e nos humilhaste, e não sais com os nossos exércitos.
verses.en_web: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
verses.en_bbe: But now you have sent us away from you, and put us to shame; you do not go out with our armies.

verses.en: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
verses.pt: Fizeste-nos voltar as costas ao inimigo e aqueles que nos odeiam nos despojam à vontade.
verses.en_web: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
verses.en_bbe: Because of this we are turned back by the attacker: those who have hate for us take our goods for themselves.

verses.en: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
verses.pt: Entregaste-nos como ovelhas para alimento, e nos espalhaste entre as nações.
verses.en_web: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
verses.en_bbe: You have made us like sheep which are taken for meat; we are put to flight among the nations.

verses.en: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.
verses.pt: Vendeste por nada o teu povo, e não lucraste com o seu preço.
verses.en_web: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
verses.en_bbe: You let your people go for nothing; your wealth is not increased by their price.

verses.en: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
verses.pt: Puseste-nos por opróbrio aos nossos vizinhos, por escárnio e zombaria àqueles que estão à roda de nós.
verses.en_web: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
verses.en_bbe: You have made us to be looked down on by our neighbours, we are laughed at and shamed by those who are round about us.

verses.en: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
verses.pt: Puseste-nos por provérbio entre as nações, por ludíbrio entre os povos.
verses.en_web: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
verses.en_bbe: Our name is a word of shame among the nations, a sign for the shaking of heads among the peoples.

verses.en: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
verses.pt: A minha ignomínia está sempre diante de mim, e a vergonha do meu rosto me cobre,
verses.en_web: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
verses.en_bbe: My downfall is ever before me, and I am covered with the shame of my face;

verses.en: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
verses.pt: à voz daquele que afronta e blasfema, à vista do inimigo e do vingador.
verses.en_web: At the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
verses.en_bbe: Because of the voice of him who says sharp and bitter words; because of the hater and him who is the instrument of punishment.

verses.en: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
verses.pt: Tudo isto nos sobreveio; todavia não nos esquecemos de ti, nem nos houvemos falsamente contra o teu pacto.
verses.en_web: All this has come on us, yet have we not forgotten you, Neither have we been false to your covenant.
verses.en_bbe: All this has come on us, but still we have kept you in our memory; and we have not been false to your word.

verses.en: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
verses.pt: O nosso coração não voltou atrás, nem os nossos passos se desviaram das tuas veredas,
verses.en_web: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
verses.en_bbe: Our hearts have not gone back, and our steps have not been turned out of your way;

verses.en: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.pt: para nos teres esmagado onde habitam os chacais, e nos teres coberto de trevas profundas.
verses.en_web: Though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.en_bbe: Though you have let us be crushed in the place of jackals, though we are covered with darkest shade.

verses.en: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
verses.pt: Se nos tivéssemos esquecido do nome do nosso Deus, e estendido as nossas mãos para um deus estranho,
verses.en_web: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god;
verses.en_bbe: If the name of our God has gone out of our minds, or if our hands have been stretched out to a strange god,

verses.en: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
verses.pt: porventura Deus não haveria de esquadrinhar isso? pois ele conhece os segredos do coração.
verses.en_web: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.en_bbe: Will not God make search for it? for he sees the secrets of the heart.

verses.en: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.pt: Mas por amor de ti somos entregues à morte o dia todo; somos considerados como ovelhas para o matadouro.
verses.en_web: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, because of you we are put to death every day; we are numbered like sheep for destruction.

verses.en: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.
verses.pt: Desperta! por que dormes, Senhor? Acorda! não nos rejeites para sempre.
verses.en_web: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
verses.en_bbe: Why are you sleeping, O Lord? awake! and come to our help, do not give us up for ever.

verses.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
verses.pt: Por que escondes o teu rosto, e te esqueces da nossa tribulação e da nossa angústia?
verses.en_web: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
verses.en_bbe: Why is your face covered, and why do you give no thought to our trouble and our cruel fate?

verses.en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
verses.pt: Pois a nossa alma está abatida até o pó; o nosso corpo pegado ao chão.
verses.en_web: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
verses.en_bbe: For our souls are crushed down to the dust: our bodies are stretched out on the earth.

verses.en: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.
verses.pt: Levanta-te em nosso auxílio, e resgata-nos por tua benignidade.
verses.en_web: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
verses.en_bbe: Up! and come to our help, and give us salvation because of your mercy.
